alana (Docs): Quick check: we need to standardize terminology across the migration guides and add one clear SDK snippet showing accessible output and naming conventions. Thoughts?
ryan (Eng): Agree. I can add a tiny JS + Python snippet returning plain_text + structured fields for assistive tech.
sunita (Product): Product rule: use 'Redwood' for product feature statements; use 'we' in tutorials. Add this to the style guide.
marc (DevEx): I'll add a lint that flags 'Redwood' vs 'we' inconsistencies and Title Case for product modes.
eva (Legal): Reminder: avoid absolutes in glossary entries (no "guaranteed" or "fully isolated"). I'll review wording.
*docbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 (alana)
alana (Docs): Plan: 1) style update with brief rules; 2) add snippets under docs/style/examples.md; 3) sweep migration guides for mismatches. Volunteers: ryan for snippets, marc for linter, eva for legal review?
ryan (Eng): I'll push snippets by Thu. Sample JS: ```js
const r = await redwood.generate({model:'rw-1-large',input:'Short bullets for screen readers',format:'json'});
console.log(r.plain_text);
console.log(r.structured?.bullets||[]);
```
marc (DevEx): Lint PR will flag lowercase/Title Case and 'we' vs 'Redwood' usage.
eva (Legal): I'll check glossary PR once opened. Suggest phrasing for Private: "Private deployment — customer-managed network boundaries; Redwood offers an optional control plane component."
alana (Docs): Timeline: style + examples PR today; snippets + linter by Thu. Thanks — will tag reviewers in PR. :white_check_mark:
